race.comment: MERINI (7) returns after a 136-day spell. Opened last prep with a half-length defeat over 1100m at Wyong. Two recent trials have been pleasing. Draws the inside alley and everything points towards a positive return. BOSSY SHEILA (6) has not appeared since being beaten narrowly on debut over 1100m at Wellington on 15 September. Four winners have come from that race. Has a tough gate to contend with but if things go right, she is a winning hope. HALCYON BELLE (11) found 1000m a bit sharp when fresh from a spell here 25 days ago. Fitter and this looks a more suitable assignment. THE DIPLOMAT (5) returns from a 137-day spell and has been gelded. Showed ability in the two runs of his maiden campaign and can take it to another level now. MAGIC ARTIST (13) is a Trapeze Artist first starter. Three siblings to race are all multiple winners. Went well in a recent Gosford trial so he looks up for this.
